title: Concept: pyproject declares no licence
description: pyproject.toml declares a pyproject that records no licence, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Redistribution rights cannot be established from the packaging metadata, which blocks release review and downstream use.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: Redistribution rights cannot be established from the packaging metadata, which blocks release review and downstream use.
